differences.p_formula: (1 + shuffles with statistic >= observed) / (shuffles + 1); max |z| is calibrated over all 58 bins; the non-zero-d statistics hold the number of repeats fixed (shuffled counts rescaled to the observed non-zero total)

homogeneity.null: symbols permuted across all sections, section lengths fixed

diffs.label: EXPLORATORY: units chosen after inspecting the data; a p-value here is not confirmation

transitions.note: expected counts are the shuffle mean per cell; the null chi-square uses the same expectation, so it is slightly conservative

label: EXPLORATORY: units chosen after inspecting the data; a p-value here is not confirmation

variants: F-robust lag comb (pairs with no F between)

power.label: SYNTHETIC: English plaintext (training split) through known mechanisms; says what each diagnostic can see, not what the real sections are

repeats.label: EXPLORATORY: units chosen after inspecting the data; a p-value here is not confirmation

position.note: one summary statistic, chosen after looking at deciles of the same data: a weak lead at most, not a confirmed trend
